subject: expression: always use the ctx in parameter for method `Equal` in all expressions (#48596)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent focusing on expression/planner/executor changes that propagate non-nil session context into `Expression.Equal` and virtual-expression column matching (`EqualByExprAndID`, `GetUsedList`, `ResolveIndicesByVirtualExpr`, `ExtractCol2Len`). Main risk area is nil `sessionctx.Context` usage after removing ScalarFunction.Equal’s internal ctx fallback; confirmed all in-scope call sites were updated to pass a real session context and repo-wide there are no remaining `.Equal(nil, ...)` call sites. Spot-checked later history: subsequent refactors continue the “no GetCtx fallback / explicit ctx” direction; no follow-up fix indicating a correctness regression from this commit.
